@graph.description: Palletizing planning tools from TRF: estimate payback with the ROI calculator, gather the right line data and build your capital request.

mainEntity.name: Is the Palletizing ROI Calculator Free to Use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The calculator is free, and the preview appears as you type. A work email unlocks the full breakdown, and TRF uses your email and inputs to follow up on your project.

mainEntity.name: How Accurate Is a Payback Estimate Made Before a Quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is an initial planning figure. It becomes sharper with your own inputs, above all your loaded labor rate, the number of people who really leave the task and an investment that includes installation and integration. Costs such as other utilities, financing, taxes and layout changes are not in the estimate, so a TRF Sales Engineer completes it.

mainEntity.name: Can I Estimate Payback for Case Packing or Conveyor Projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: The calculator is built for palletizing, and the same labor logic applies to case packing. For a case packing or conveyor systems project, talk with a TRF Sales Engineer about your products, rates and layout, and the engineer will build the estimate with you.

mainEntity.name: What Is the Next Step After I Run the Numbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact a TRF Sales Engineer with your product weight, rate per line, shifts and a sketch of the available area. The engineer confirms the platform, defines the scope and prepares a quote with the full installed cost for your line, replacing the reference values in the estimate with validated ones.
